# JerseyPro — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> An online store specializing in football jerseys from all leagues and types worldwide, with an additional selection of basketball jerseys. The store targets sports fans and collectors who want authentic or replica jerseys from their favorite teams. The product range is broad, covering multiple sports leagues globally, making it a one-stop-shop for sports apparel enthusiasts.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About JerseyPro
An online store specializing in football jerseys from all leagues and types worldwide, with an additional selection of basketball jerseys. The store targets sports fans and collectors who want authentic or replica jerseys from their favorite teams. The product range is broad, covering multiple sports leagues globally, making it a one-stop-shop for sports apparel enthusiasts.

## Target Audience
- אוהדי כדורגל וכדורסל
- משתתפי ספורט צעירים
- הורים לקבוצות ספורט
- אוהדי ספורט בינלאומיים

## Industry
E-commerce / Sports Apparel
